name: agentics-kit
description: Agentics plugin kit — developer tools, code review, planning, and CLAUDE.md optimization

metadata.description: Agentics plugin kit — developer tools, code review, planning, and CLAUDE.md optimization

plugins.name: memory-tools
plugins.description: Audit and optimize CLAUDE.md project memory files against Claude Code best practices

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Structured multi-dimensional code review across quality, bugs, security, best practices, complexity rating, breaking changes, and regressions

plugins.name: plan-interview
plugins.description: Stress-test implementation plans with structured multi-round interviews before coding begins — auto-routes product plans to the panel review skill, always emits an interview HTML artifact

plugins.name: wcag-compliance-reviewer
plugins.description: Review HTML/CSS and React/TypeScript code for WCAG 2.2 Level AA accessibility compliance

plugins.name: skill-reviewer
plugins.description: Review and optimize Claude Code skill files — score SKILL.md quality, plan and scaffold new skills, audit allowed-tools permissions, optimize frontmatter (descriptions + disable-model-invocation), and enforce the three-part 200-char description format

plugins.name: code-testing-agent
plugins.description: Analyze code and suggest specific, purpose-driven tests tied to actual behavior and intent — not arbitrary coverage

plugins.name: git-agent
plugins.description: Automated git workflow — create branches, commit with conventional messages, create PRs, and open GitHub/GitLab issues from any context (selection, session, bug, feature) with host auto-detection and confirmation gate; ships background subagents and slash commands for fire-and-forget commit/PR/ship plus auto-linking plan issue references in PR descriptions

plugins.name: product-plans
plugins.description: Improve, optimize, and update product plans, PRDs, and feature proposals using a cross-functional Agent Team (PM, Lead Developer, UX, Frontend, Accessibility, Security) — produces a 15-section consolidated report, applies improvements to the source plan, and appends findings to any existing plan-interview HTML artifact

plugins.name: settings-sync
plugins.description: Back up and restore Claude Code user settings to a dedicated git repo — routine-compatible for automated backups

plugins.name: social-media-tools
plugins.description: Discover teachable code, blog posts, videos, GitHub snippets, and selected/pasted code — scrub for secrets, draft instructional platform-aware copy with concrete takeaways, and generate styled dark-mode social cards for LinkedIn, Twitter/X, Bluesky, and Substack, plus a write-guide skill that writes long-form internal developer explainer guides to docs/

plugins.name: plan-agent
plugins.description: Plan creation, review, and follow-through. implementation-plan authors a Markdown plan spec and renders it into a self-contained interactive HTML plan with copy-paste implement and goal prompts; review-plan runs a seven-reviewer Agent Team (architecture, completeness, testability, risk, conventions, UX, accessibility) that improves the plan in place; finalize-plan verifies completion evidence and marks plans done; build-proposal turns a vague idea into a decision-complete proposal; write-prompt builds prompts from Anthropic best practices; prototype turns a plan, idea, image, or Figma design into a runnable static-HTML prototype; setup-sites scaffolds GitHub Pages publishing; plans-library and plans-open browse the plan gallery. Accepts GitHub/GitLab issue URLs and .md plans as input; hooks enforce verb-target filenames and auto-rebuild the gallery index. Full feature detail in the plugin README and CHANGELOG.

plugins.name: team-defaults
plugins.description: Shared team defaults — documentation and design-token agents plus a sync-rules skill that installs the team's global rules into ~/.claude/rules/

plugins.name: artifact-tools
plugins.description: Publish diffs, sessions, plans, and prompts as live claude.ai artifact pages — an annotated diff walkthrough with per-hunk reviewer notes, a reviewer-first session recap, plan HTML republished to a stable URL, and saved prompts published singly or as a filterable library with verbatim copy buttons — with a blocking secret-scrub gate and a local-HTML fallback

removed.name: issue-agent
removed.reason: Absorbed into git-agent v3.11.0 — create-issue skill now lives at /git-agent:create-issue. Reduces plugin count without losing functionality.

removed.name: agent-creator
removed.reason: Redundant with agentic-plugin-dev, which already scaffolds full plugins including agents

removed.name: agent-reviewer
removed.reason: Overlaps with skill-reviewer, which covers plugin component auditing more broadly

removed.name: react-perf-analyzer
removed.reason: Too specialized — only useful in React projects; general perf issues are covered by code-review

removed.name: agentic-plugin-dev
removed.reason: Removed from marketplace; directory retained for reference — plugin scaffolding covered by existing skills

removed.name: code-simplifier
removed.reason: Removed from marketplace; directory retained for reference — structural analysis covered by code-review
